prompt:
SURFACE: the new quote builder page "/cotizar" of a Venezuelan travel agency, desktop 1440 wide, first viewport plus a bit. Top: a slim solid header 64px (logo "Destino y Eventos Lotus 360" with a small round orange-to-gold mark at left; "Promociones  Hoteles  Paquetes  Guías y tours" links; right a green "WhatsApp" button and heart, bag, user line icons). Title "Arme su viaje" in condensed bold with one line subtitle "Elija hotel, vuelo y tours. Le enviamos un estimado al instante.". Under it a trip bar card spanning the content width with four labelled fields separated by hairlines — "Destino  Margarita", "Fechas  12 – 16 oct · 4 noches" (mono), "Viajeros  2 adultos · 1 niño (7)", and a group "Servicios" with multi-select chips "Hospedaje" (selected, filled), "Vuelo" (selected, filled), "Full day y tours" (outlined, not selected) plus a small text link "Paquete completo". Below, two columns. LEFT COLUMN: section heading "Hospedaje en Margarita" with filter chips "Todo incluido", "Niños gratis", "Menor precio" and a sort label "Recomendadas"; a 3-column grid of hotel offer cards: each card a 4:3 resort photo, a small green-sea tag "Niño gratis" on some, hotel name in condensed bold, "Todo incluido · Playa El Agua", then a ticket-stub bottom with "Estimado 4 noches" and "$640" in mono and a coral outlined button "Elegir". The first card is highlighted with a coral 2px border and a small check "Elegido". The fifth card is greyed out with the label "Sin disponibilidad del 12 al 15 oct" and no button. RIGHT COLUMN (sticky, 380px): a boarding-pass style summary card titled "Su cotización": item 1 small photo + "Hesperia Playa El Agua" + "Todo incluido · Doble estándar" + "12–16 oct · 4 noches" + "$640" in mono; a dashed perforation; item 2 plane line icon + "Vuelo Caracas (CCS) – Porlamar (PMV)" + "ida y vuelta · 3 pasajeros" + "Precio a confirmar"; at the bottom a dusk band with "Estimado" and "$640" large in gold mono, small grey note "Sujeto a disponibilidad. El asesor confirma el precio final."; a full-width orange button "Solicitar cotización" and a green outlined "Consultar por WhatsApp".
STYLE (fixed, do not reinterpret): DARK THEME palette exactly — page background deep marine #12262b, cards #1c3238 lifted by a hairline light border rgba(255,255,255,.12), text #eef3f1 / #9db3b0, accent links and selected states #FF8A3D, the single signature call-to-action orange #FC7300 with dark text #3a1505, gold #FBC000 for prices on dark, WhatsApp green #0f7a40 only on the WhatsApp button. No sand or cream surfaces anywhere. Typography: headlines in Archivo condensed bold (airport signage), body in Figtree, every price, code and date in Space Mono. The brand gradient orange #FC7300 to gold #FBC000 appears only as a thin edge on a ticket stub and on an active-tab underline, never behind text. Radii 12-16px, matte flat surfaces, a surface is lifted by a hairline border OR a soft shadow, never both. Icons are thin 2px line icons; no emoji, no unicode glyphs, no small uppercase "eyebrow" label above any heading. All UI copy in Spanish exactly as written here, formal "usted" voice.
REFERENCE IMAGE: the attached image is an approved comp of this same website's home. Carry over ONLY its palette, type voice, boarding-pass card language and overall polish. Do NOT copy its hero or composition: this is a different page, the quote builder.
OUTPUT: a flat, high-fidelity UI design comp as a straight-on screenshot of the page that fills the whole image edge to edge (no outer margin, no frame, no device frame, no perspective, no hands, no desk). Never render font names, hex codes or any of these instructions as visible text. It must read as a professional travel agency quote builder: level of polish Booking/Despegar checkout meets Airbnb (big photos, air, price always visible). Hotel names and prices are placeholders.
